text: S630 closed as an official-source audit. CLO's menu help does not specify a profile edition or button mark mapping; ASTM D6673-10 is withdrawn with no replacement and the public record omits entity/layer clauses; NISTIR 5969 is a 1997 STEP/EXPRESS model, not a DXF-AAMA encoding. Its inspected mark figure is typed point/location and defines no button circle/radius. S628 AC1009 is R11/R12, while D6673-10's public scope names Version 13. No source-backed conversion hypothesis, gate, threshold, status or acceptance changes. Next inspect the already existing S617 ASTM-labeled output and saved render offline, then select any further receiver operation only from concrete observed evidence. See E-G04-S630-EXIT.
